subject: per-vt-u-fund
title: PER.VT.U.FUND.------PROG.CONT.
description: Second diagram on page 368 (R(AS)CM(II)-12). The crossing diagrams how the central periodic-vibrational-universe-fundament structurally meets progressional-continuance through the central-information bridging hub: (C)PER-VT-U-FUND (central periodic vibrational-universe fundament — the form's actual vibrational ground over time) crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). PER-VT-U-FUND sits on the left with the subject-arrow; AFI (affinity insight) hangs at upper-left as the subject-side upper output. C-INFO (central information) sits centrally as the bridging hub; PROJ-DYM (projection dynamism) rises above the hub, SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) drops to the lower-left as the bridging-side downward output, with PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) at bottom-center and POL-DYM (political dynamism) at bottom-right, and MT-INFO (meta-information) at right-center. PROG-CONT sits at upper-right as partner-axis with TRS (transformation) on the right margin as partner-side downward output. Structural argument: when periodic-vibrational-universe-fundament is crossed with progressional-continuance, the central C-INFO hub is what carries the form's actual vibrational ground into the partner-axis. C-INFO → PROJ-DYM at the top is the upward route — central-information routes into projection-dynamism, the partner-side's working projection. The downward chain C-INFO → SOC-RT-DY / PHY-U-P / POL-DYM is the partner-side's downward outputs: social-reality-dynamics, physical-universe particulars, and political-dynamism all routed through the central hub. C-INFO → MT-INFO at the right is the partner-axis's meta-information output. The diagram's structural argument is that PROG-CONT → TRS on the partner-axis right side reaches the form only through the C-INFO hub — without the hub holding all six edges, progressional-continuance produces transformation on the partner-side alone, without the subject's vibrational-fundament carrying the projection through projection-dynamism's working axis.
